carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple dark, elongated silhouettes, consistent with remoras, are visible attached to the ventral surface of the shark, posterior to the pectoral fin.
